# Business Lens Lab

> Independent first-principles research laboratory helping business owners, legal professionals, fleet operators, and builders understand software, AI agents, and digital systems before investing.

- Website: https://businesslenslab.com/
- Methodology: https://businesslenslab.com/how-we-explain.html
- Full Research Library: https://businesslenslab.com/articles.html
- Categories Hub: https://businesslenslab.com/categories.html
- Resources & Blueprints: https://businesslenslab.com/resources.html
- XML Sitemap: https://businesslenslab.com/sitemap.xml

## Editorial Standards
- Every review includes plain-English glossaries, live dashboard audits, three-year total cost of ownership math, verified case studies, and unvarnished limitations.
- Zero paid placements. Independent evaluations backed by transparent affiliate disclosure (https://businesslenslab.com/affiliate-disclosure.html).
